title: Call Center Agents Analysis
description: A service-operations dashboard comparing call volume, reasons for contact, satisfaction, talk time, waiting time and agent-level patterns.
question: What can call-centre activity reveal about customer-contact demand and service performance?
design: Presented operational KPIs beside call-reason rankings, monthly and weekday trends, talk-time patterns and an agent table. This makes both overall workload and more detailed variations visible.
focus: Contact reasons show major demand categories
Time trends distinguish monthly and weekday patterns
Talk time, wait time and satisfaction provide complementary service measures
An agent-level table supports detailed follow-up while summary cards preserve context
reflection: A service dashboard should avoid treating a single metric as the whole story; workload and customer experience need to be seen together.
coverAlt: Original Call Center Agents Analysis Power BI dashboard showing call counts, satisfaction, talk time, wait time, call-reason charts and agent-level measures
